items.title: Chibi Fashion
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Chibi chibi! Cute and cuddly designs! Oh, I just want to hug you right now! So cute!

- 10 roleplay skins!
- Cute attire inspired by chibi art!

items.title: Teen Style
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Modern teen skins are among us! If you like fashion, this modern city clothing skin pack is perfect for you! Enjoy unique colorful outfits and beautiful styles! These teens are all about the fashion world. Be pretty, cute, and cool while finding your next favorite skin today!

+ 12 skins in total
+ Perfect for teens!

items.title: High School Uniforms
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Are you doing a high school roleplay? This skin pack has the perfect lineup of school uniforms that can be used on any server! Are you ready to match with your friends? 

- 12 modern teen skins with high school uniforms!
- Perfect for roleplaying!

items.title: Cute Mob Onesies
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ever wondered what it's like to be your favourite mob? Well, now's your chance! With these cute mob onesies, you can get cozy and look like the mob you love! 

- Includes 10 mob-themed onesie skins!

items.title: Animal Scientists
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you love animals and science? If so, then you will love this pack! Choose your spirit animal and become the coolest scientist!

- 10 unique skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Pastel Anime
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you an anime fan? If so, then Pastel Anime is perfect for you! With artistic and pastel shading, you can surprise your friends with your new look! Go roleplay in a city, or if you want, parkour through a sakura garden!

- 14 pastel-colored, anime skins!
- Perfect for teens!
- By Withercore

items.title: Millionaire Treehouse Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Treehouse Mansion is a mansion with everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a beautiful unique tree, you will have no issues hanging out with the rich folk among us! Everyone will be jealous of your awesome base! Explore all the luxury it has to offer.

- Mega mansion
- Modern design
- Great with friends!

items.title: All-Inclusive Resort
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Live a life of luxurious lavishness with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Welcome to the All-Inclusive Resort, where all the poshest cube heads come to cut loose and have fun. Lounge on the beach, shoot down the waterslide, or take out some of your pent-up frustrations on the nearby baddies. However you like to spend your free time, we've got you covered!

items.title: Vanilla Furniture
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Enhance your vanilla experience with craftable furniture! Craft over 120 unique decor models and decorate modern homes and mansions around the world.
+ Over 120 unique decor models
+ Interactive animations
+ Tools
+ Includes Superstore and Mansions

! Furniture usable on world provided

+ 10 adorable pastel skins!
+ 1 FREE skin: Dawn

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Fantasy Teens

items.description:
In a world where magic starts taking over...
Get dressed up in these medieval outfits and roleplay away with your friends! A collection of magical skins from the adventure in Quintenia!

+ 25 mystical skins
+ FREE Skin: Jesper
+ Be a real Quintenian

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Galactic Armor Crew
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Blast through the galaxy with the latest and greatest space armor! You and your crew will be ready to take on whatever the stars throw at you.

Space is only a blink away.

+ 10 galactic skins!
+ Free skin: Star Jumper

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Cow Friends

items.description:
These cow teens are perfect for roleplay and epic adventures!
* 24 HD skins!
* Don't cry over spilt milk!

items.title: Professors
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These smart skins are perfect for helping with your Minecraft high school homework! 
* Great for city roleplay!

items.title: 1982 Teens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These epic city high school teens are ready to hang out in 1982! 
* Perfect for retro roleplay!

items.title: Crypto Robots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Communicate in secret code when you role-play with friends in Crypto Robots skins. Geared up in vibrant colors, electronic signals will pulse all through your high-tech, mechanical machine parts. Become a technological wonder bot, able to encrypt and decrypt millions of lines of covert messages in a millisecond!

+ 8 brilliant digital droid HD skins

items.title: Enhanced Camo
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s the perfect Minecraft disguise! Gear up and become undetectable with Enhanced Camo skins. Role-play with friends in all the popular blocks like explosive TNT, fiery magma, solid endstone, and tall grass. With the intense detail on these skins, you will easily blend in to the background and no one will ever ever see you.

+ 8 super camouflage HD skins

items.title: Demon Glitches
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Is that a mischievous look in your eye? Maybe it’s a glitch! Role-play with friends as a most imperfect little devil in Demon Glitches skins. In horns just a little bit defective and clothes with funky flaws, get ready to play some buggy tricks. Your pranks might malfunction, but it’s all in good fun!

+ 8 erring evil spirit HD skins

items.title: Gamers Squad
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Stay up all night playing your favorite video games. Talk with friends using an awesome headset. With lots of skins to choose from, role-play in cool clothes like hoodies and T-shirts. Make an all-star team and beat the competition!

+ 8 skilled HD skins

items.title: Flowers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Brighten up the city, school, or wherever you go in lovely Flower skins. Fresh from the garden, role-play with friends and get together to make a stunning, sweet-smelling bouquet or arrangement. Become a blue orchid, purple lilac, or red tulip and show off your pretty petals. With buds that burst into blooms, experience real flower power.

+ 8 beautiful blossoming HD skins

items.title: High School Party
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Get all dressed up and look your best. You’re invited to a High School Party! Role-play with friends in fancy skins fit for some fun festivities. Show up in a smart dinner jacket or snazzy vest and tie, looking good. Walk into the party in a gorgeous evening gown or adorable dress and look real sharp. Enjoy a great get-together!

+ 8 social celebration HD skins

items.title: Teen Rabbits
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Time to hop about town and see the sights! Have a jumping good time when you role-play with friends in Teen Rabbits skins. In cool, chic styles, twitch your whiskers while you explore the city. Show off your soft and furry side as you skip down the street. You look lovelier than most by leaps and bounds!

+ 8 cute cottontailed HD skins

items.title: Angels vs Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Halo or horns? Float around in heavenly white or storm about in devilish red when you role-play with friends in Angels vs Demons skins. Be the most divine presence with awesome wings and godly grin. Switch roles and gear up in a sinister smile while causing some trouble. Good or bad, time to choose your manner of devotion!

+ 8 blessed vs. wicked HD skins
